entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: A tiger-man Ojanen who joins the Robarans, becomes general of the Efravans and later chief of the Robarans.

entities.name: Hazezon
entities.description: A sorcerer whose magic helps the Robarans reach Johan's flagship; he later governs Bryce.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: Leader of the Circle of Seveners who devises the plan to attack Johan's ship and is killed by him.

entities.name: Circle of Seveners
entities.description: Adira's band, who accompany Jedit and Hazezon.

entities.name: Robarans
entities.description: The pirate group of Jedit and his allies who later become explorers and colonists.

entities.name: Johan
entities.description: The Tirran emperor and sorcerer who builds an airship fleet to invade; protected by an Indestructible Aura, he is eaten by a sand wurm.

entities.name: Tirras
entities.description: Johan's realm, whose army scatters after his death.

entities.name: Bryce
entities.description: City targeted by Johan, where the airship fleet is built and Hazezon becomes governor.

entities.name: Efrava
entities.description: Oasis village of cat people, Johan's first target.

entities.name: Blue Mountains
entities.description: Mountains over which the stolen ship flies before crashing into a Magnetic Mountain.

entities.name: Scarwood
entities.description: Hidden city where Terrent Amese created the first Ojanen, later home to half-elves.

entities.name: Terrent Amese
entities.description: Creator of the first Ojanen, who created Ur-Drago to avenge a perceived betrayal.

entities.name: Ur-Drago
entities.description: An elemental created by Terrent Amese to exact revenge, slain by Jedit.

entities.name: Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
entities.description: Place whose walls show the history of the cat people.

entities.name: Ojanen
entities.description: The first tiger-man warrior created by Terrent Amese, who asked to be freed; the ghost was his lover.

entities.name: Cat ghost
entities.description: A ghost, lover of the first Ojanen, who guides Jedit and seeks vengeance.

entities.name: Koltos
entities.description: Island where Alchor's Tomb lies, said to hold powerstones.

entities.name: Alchor's Tomb
entities.description: A tomb on Koltos said to be a deposit of powerstones.

entities.name: Ramirez DePietro
entities.description: Corsair who captures fishermen to dig powerstones for Johan; defeated by the Robarans.

entities.name: Tor Wauki
entities.description: Corsair allied with DePietro.

entities.name: Infernal Medusa
entities.description: A creature used to control islanders on Koltos.

entities.name: Master of the Hunt
entities.description: A demigod on Koltos who cures Jedit and helps defeat DePietro.

entities.name: Hestia
entities.description: A companion who goes with Jedit to seek help from other cat tribes.

entities.name: Khyyiani
entities.description: A mad cat tribe.

entities.name: Hooraree
entities.description: A cat tribe that makes a tenuous covenant with Jedit.

entities.name: Sulaki
entities.description: A frenzied cat tribe that sends nearly all its warriors to the battle.

entities.name: People of the Pines
entities.description: Warriors who come with Hazezon to the battle.

entities.name: Prophecy of None, One, and Two
entities.description: An infamous prophecy whose meaning remains unclear.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the story is set.

events.summary: Jedit, Hazezon, Adira and the Seveners infiltrate Tirras to assassinate Johan but are captured; Hazezon and Adira are imprisoned, the rest sent to a work camp where Jedit learns of airships.
events.quote: they are quickly discovered and captured

events.summary: The Robarans steal an airship, rouse the slaves, rescue Hazezon and Adira, but Johan's storm throws them off course.
events.quote: The Robarans manage to steal a ship, rouse the slaves, and sail through the air toward Tirras.

events.summary: The ship is thrown against a Magnetic Mountain, killing many, and the survivors resolve to travel on foot to the sea.
events.quote: killing a lot of its passengers

events.summary: Jedit is visited by a cat ghost and the party helps the half-elves of Scarwood against giant apes.
events.quote: Jedit and the others help the elves against the apes

events.summary: In the Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale Jedit learns the history of the cat warriors and that the ghost was Ojanen's lover; he slays Ur-Drago but is gravely wounded.
events.quote: Ur-Drago attacks Jedit and the tiger man manages to slay his foe

events.summary: Jedit is rescued and taken to Bryce, where the fleet needs powerstones; Adira and Jedit sail for Koltos.
events.quote: Adira and Jedit sail towards the island of Koltos

events.summary: On Koltos a Master of the Hunt heals Jedit and helps defeat DePietro, freeing the fishermen and gaining powerstones.
events.quote: the demigod not only cures Jedit of his wounds

events.summary: Jedit and Adira fly to Efrava, where Jedit's claim to be the first Ojanen is met coldly; he seeks help from other cat tribes and gains the Hooraree and Sulaki.
events.quote: he manages to make a tenuous covenant with the Hooraree

events.summary: Johan attacks Efrava; Jedit, now general of the Efravans, leads guerrilla warfare and allied reinforcements retake the village, and Adira devises a plan to attack Johan's ship.
events.quote: the alliance manages to recapture the village of the Efravans

events.summary: The Robarans reach Johan's flagship; Adira stabs Johan but is killed by him; Jedit and Johan fall to the desert where a sand wurm eats Johan.
events.quote: a sand wurm emerges from the dunes and eats him

events.summary: With Johan dead, Tirras scatters; Jedit becomes chief of the Robarans and Hazezon governor of Bryce before travelling the world.
events.quote: decides to become the new chief of the Robarans

relations.note: Johan kills Adira after surviving her stab

relations.quote: the tiger man manages to slay his foe
created the elemental Ur-Drago to exact his revenge
the hidden city where Terrent Amese created the first Ojanen

relations.note: Jedit becomes chief of the Robarans
relations.quote: decides to become the new chief of the Robarans
Hazezon returns to be governor of Bryce
